prompt: launch video for a note-taking app

plan.title: A note-taking app that finds your ideas for you
plan.description: A launch video for a note-taking app that helps you capture ideas fast and find them again in seconds. See how capture, organize and search work together.

beats.narration: Your best idea just vanished. It was on a sticky note, or in a chat, or in your head. Notes should not be this hard to find. So we built a note-taking app that keeps them.

props.alt: hands taking notes on a notebook

beats.narration: It works in three simple steps. First, capture: type, speak or snap a photo in one tap. Second, organize: your notes sort themselves into folders and tags. Third, find: search brings back the right note in seconds.

steps.label: Capture
steps.detail: Type, speak or snap a photo

steps.label: Organize
steps.detail: Folders and tags, done for you

beats.narration: You will not need to think hard about where things go. Write first, and worry about the rest later. Your thoughts stay with you, so the idea you had on the train is still there when you sit down.
Less hunting, more doing. Meetings, reading lists, plans and half-formed thoughts can all be kept in one place, ready when you are. Picture a calmer day.

props.clip_query: person typing on laptop in cafe
clip_queries: person typing on laptop in cafe

beats.narration: Download the app and write down your next idea. Capture it once, and find it whenever you need it.

props.text: Capture it once. Find it whenever you need it.
